proposal.expected_benefit: Prevents ambiguities in control implementation, ensuring robust enforcement of audit and compliance requirements and reducing the risk of bypassing security measures.
proposal.problem: Contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions may lead to ambiguities in control implementation, potentially allowing the attack to bypass intended security measures.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a unified enforcement framework that explicitly aligns audit and compliance controls. This framework should ensure that audit requirements are non-negotiable and that compliance decisions are subject to audit validation, eliminating ambiguities in control implementation.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement Alignment
verification_tests: Validate that audit status is non-negotiable in all compliance decisions
Ensure compliance decisions are subject to audit validation
Confirm no contradictions exist between audit and compliance enforcement mechanisms
